title: Garmin overview
description: Health, sleep, fitness and activities from the Garmin archive.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, (payload->>'restingHeartRate')::float8 AS "Resting heart rate"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'user_summary' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND (payload->>'restingHeartRate') IS NOT NULL 
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, (payload->'hrvSummary'->>'lastNightAvg')::float8 AS "HRV"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'hrv' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND (payload->'hrvSummary'->>'lastNightAvg') IS NOT NULL 
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, ((payload->'dailySleepDTO'->>'sleepTimeSeconds')::numeric / 3600)::float8 AS "Sleep"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'sleep' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND ((payload->'dailySleepDTO'->>'sleepTimeSeconds')::numeric / 3600) IS NOT NULL 
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, (payload->'dailySleepDTO'->'sleepScores'->'overall'->>'value')::float8 AS "Sleep score"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'sleep' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND (payload->'dailySleepDTO'->'sleepScores'->'overall'->>'value') IS NOT NULL 
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, (payload->>'bodyBatteryAtWakeTime')::float8 AS "Body Battery at wake"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'user_summary' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND (payload->>'bodyBatteryAtWakeTime') IS NOT NULL 
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, ((SELECT e->>'score' FROM jsonb_array_elements(payload) e
          ORDER BY (e->>'inputContext' = 'AFTER_WAKEUP_RESET') DESC NULLS LAST, e->>'timestamp' DESC LIMIT 1))::float8 AS "Training readiness"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'training_readiness' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND ((SELECT e->>'score' FROM jsonb_array_elements(payload) e
          ORDER BY (e->>'inputContext' = 'AFTER_WAKEUP_RESET') DESC NULLS LAST, e->>'timestamp' DESC LIMIT 1)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'array'
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg steps
panels.description: Average steps per day over the selected time range, without today.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, (payload->>'totalSteps')::float8 AS "Steps"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'user_summary' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND (payload->>'totalSteps') IS NOT NULL AND day < current_date
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, (payload->'mostRecentVO2Max'->'generic'->>'vo2MaxPreciseValue')::float8 AS "VO2 max"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'training_status' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND (payload->'mostRecentVO2Max'->'generic'->>'vo2MaxPreciseValue') IS NOT NULL 
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, v::float8 AS "Daily", avg7::float8 AS "7-day average"
  FROM (SELECT day, v,
               round(avg(v) OVER (ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS avg7
          FROM (SELECT day, (payload->>'restingHeartRate')::numeric AS v
                  FROM archive.daily
                 WHERE source = 'user_summary'
                   AND day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date - 6 AND $__timeTo()::date) a
         WHERE v IS NOT NULL AND TRUE) b
 WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: HRV, overnight
panels.description: The shaded band is the balanced range Garmin works out from your own baseline.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time,
       (payload->'hrvSummary'->>'lastNightAvg')::float8 AS "Nightly",
       (payload->'hrvSummary'->>'weeklyAvg')::float8 AS "7-day average",
       (payload->'hrvSummary'->'baseline'->>'balancedLow')::float8 AS "Balanced range, lower",
       (payload->'hrvSummary'->'baseline'->>'balancedUpper')::float8 AS "Balanced range, upper"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'hrv' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND (payload->'hrvSummary'->>'lastNightAvg') IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time,
       round((s->>'deepSleepSeconds')::numeric / 3600, 2)::float8 AS "Deep",
       round((s->>'lightSleepSeconds')::numeric / 3600, 2)::float8 AS "Light",
       round((s->>'remSleepSeconds')::numeric / 3600, 2)::float8 AS "REM",
       round((s->>'awakeSleepSeconds')::numeric / 3600, 2)::float8 AS "Awake"
  FROM (SELECT day, payload->'dailySleepDTO' AS s
          FROM archive.daily WHERE source = 'sleep' AND $__timeFilter(day)) t
 WHERE s->>'sleepTimeSeconds' IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, v::float8 AS "Nightly", avg7::float8 AS "7-day average"
  FROM (SELECT day, v,
               round(avg(v) OVER (ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS avg7
          FROM (SELECT day, (payload->'dailySleepDTO'->'sleepScores'->'overall'->>'value')::numeric AS v
                  FROM archive.daily
                 WHERE source = 'sleep'
                   AND day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date - 6 AND $__timeTo()::date) a
         WHERE v IS NOT NULL AND TRUE) b
 WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, (payload->>'totalSteps')::float8 AS "Steps"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'user_summary' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND (payload->>'totalSteps') IS NOT NULL 
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, v::float8 AS "Daily", avg7::float8 AS "7-day average"
  FROM (SELECT day, v,
               round(avg(v) OVER (ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS avg7
          FROM (SELECT day, (payload->>'averageStressLevel')::numeric AS v
                  FROM archive.daily
                 WHERE source = 'user_summary'
                   AND day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date - 6 AND $__timeTo()::date) a
         WHERE v IS NOT NULL AND v > 0) b
 WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Body Battery, daily high and low

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time,
       (payload->>'bodyBatteryHighestValue')::float8 AS "High",
       (payload->>'bodyBatteryLowestValue')::float8 AS "Low"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'user_summary' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND payload->>'bodyBatteryHighestValue' IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, (payload->'mostRecentVO2Max'->'generic'->>'vo2MaxPreciseValue')::float8 AS "VO2 max"
  FROM archive.daily
 WHERE source = 'training_status' AND $__timeFilter(day) AND (payload->'mostRecentVO2Max'->'generic'->>'vo2MaxPreciseValue') IS NOT NULL 
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, v::float8 AS "Morning", avg7::float8 AS "7-day average"
  FROM (SELECT day, v,
               round(avg(v) OVER (ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS avg7
          FROM (SELECT day, ((SELECT e->>'score' FROM jsonb_array_elements(payload) e
          ORDER BY (e->>'inputContext' = 'AFTER_WAKEUP_RESET') DESC NULLS LAST, e->>'timestamp' DESC LIMIT 1))::numeric AS v
                  FROM archive.daily
                 WHERE source = 'training_readiness'
                   AND day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date - 6 AND $__timeTo()::date) a
         WHERE v IS NOT NULL AND TRUE) b
 WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp((w->>'timestampGMT')::float8 / 1000) AS time,
       round((w->>'weight')::numeric / 1000, 1)::float8 AS "Weight"
  FROM archive.daily d, jsonb_array_elements(d.payload->'dateWeightList') w
 WHERE d.source = 'weigh_ins' AND $__timeFilter(d.day) AND w->>'weight' IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', start_time) AS time,
       round(coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'running'), 0) / 3600, 2)::float8 AS "Running",
       round(coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'walking'), 0) / 3600, 2)::float8 AS "Walking and hiking",
       round(coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'strength'), 0) / 3600, 2)::float8 AS "Strength",
       round(coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'other'), 0) / 3600, 2)::float8 AS "Other"
  FROM (SELECT start_time, (summary->>'duration')::numeric AS seconds,
               CASE WHEN activity_type IN ('running', 'treadmill_running', 'track_running', 'trail_running') THEN 'running'
                    WHEN activity_type IN ('walking', 'hiking', 'mountaineering', 'stair_climbing') THEN 'walking'
                    WHEN activity_type = 'strength_training' THEN 'strength'
                    ELSE 'other' END AS kind
          FROM archive.activity
         WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)) a
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Training load
panels.description: Acute load from the primary training device. The shaded band is Garmin's optimal range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time,
       (v->'acuteTrainingLoadDTO'->>'dailyTrainingLoadAcute')::float8 AS "Acute load",
       (v->'acuteTrainingLoadDTO'->>'minTrainingLoadChronic')::float8 AS "Optimal range, lower",
       (v->'acuteTrainingLoadDTO'->>'maxTrainingLoadChronic')::float8 AS "Optimal range, upper"
  FROM archive.daily d
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT e.v FROM jsonb_each(d.payload->'mostRecentTrainingStatus'->'latestTrainingStatusData') e(k, v)
        ORDER BY (e.v->>'primaryTrainingDevice' = 'true') DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) s
 WHERE d.source = 'training_status' AND $__timeFilter(d.day)
   AND v->'acuteTrainingLoadDTO'->>'dailyTrainingLoadAcute' IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY 1

SELECT start_time AS "Date",
       summary->>'activityName' AS "Activity",
       upper(left(activity_type, 1)) || replace(substr(activity_type, 2), '_', ' ') AS "Type",
       round((summary->>'duration')::numeric)::int AS "Duration",
       round(nullif((summary->>'distance')::numeric, 0) / 1000, 2)::float8 AS "Distance",
       round((summary->>'averageHR')::numeric)::int AS "Average HR",
       round((summary->>'calories')::numeric)::int AS "Calories",
       round((summary->>'activityTrainingLoad')::numeric)::int AS "Training load"
  FROM archive.activity
 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
 ORDER BY start_time DESC
 LIMIT 200

panels.title: Nightly sync
panels.description: OK: a run finished without errors in the last 30 hours. Partial: it finished with errors. Stale: no run finished in the last 30 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(status = 'ok') THEN 'OK'
            WHEN bool_or(status = 'partial') THEN 'Partial'
            ELSE 'Stale' END AS "Nightly sync"
  FROM archive.sync_run
 WHERE finished_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 hours'

SELECT started_at AS "Started", command AS "Command", status AS "Status",
       round(extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at))::int AS "Duration",
       (detail->>'saved')::int AS "Saved",
       (detail->>'error_count')::int AS "Errors"
  FROM archive.sync_run
 ORDER BY id DESC
 LIMIT 10
SELECT max(finished_at) AS "Last run without errors" FROM archive.sync_run WHERE status = 'ok'
